data.one_liner: Automatically generates a loading skeleton widget from your own widget tree.
data.what_it_does: Allows you to wrap any widget with an extension method to automatically display a redacted, animated loading placeholder. It supports common widgets like Text, Column, Row, Container, and Image, and offers customization for colors, animation duration, and border radius.
use_when: You want to display loading skeletons that mirror your actual UI structure.
You need an easy way to toggle between loading states and real data on specific widgets.
avoid_when: You are using complex unsupported widgets that cannot be automatically measured and redacted.
You need a custom loading builder completely separate from your widget tree layout.
strengths: Easy to apply via extension methods on existing widgets.
Supports hiding or keeping specific children unredacted within the tree.
weaknesses: Limited to a specific set of supported widgets currently.
Does not support stateful widgets directly.

alternatives.name: shimmer
alternatives.why_pick_it: Pick shimmer if you prefer building custom skeleton layouts using shimmer effects rather than automatically converting your existing widgets.
